title: Interaction state matrix and ARIA gap log
content:
Purpose This is a working audit and action log focusing on component interaction states (hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error) and ARIA/voiceover coverage across the Console component library. It is intended to: 1) make visible gaps that cause regressions in keyboard and screen-reader flows, 2) propose minimal, priority fixes suitable for a 1–2 sprint scope, and 3) capture wireframe callouts for the upcoming micro-interaction refresh. Scope - Components covered: primary button, secondary button, dropdown/select, combobox, table row actions, pagination, modal dialogs, toast/inline alerts, sidebar navigation, tokenized input (chips), and form field groups. - Platforms: desktop Chrome + macOS VoiceOver, Windows NVDA/Chrome, ChromeOS + ChromeVox. Mobile interactions will be tracked separately. Methodology - Manual exploratory pass by product-console + design (Ava + Marco) to map interaction states. - Keyboard-only walkthroughs of common flows (create model route, create dedicated queue, invite user). - Screen reader pass focusing on label announcements, role correctness, and state reporting. - Quick smoke tests against existing stories in Storybook. Summary findings (high level) - Focus outline inconsistencies: several components (secondary button, pagination arrows) rely on invisible focus styles; in dark theme the contrast is insufficient. - ARIA state omissions: combobox list item pressed/selected states are not exposed as aria-selected; keyboard focus can land on items that are not announced. - Modal focus trap edge cases: when a modal contains an upstream autosuggest, closing and rapidly re-opening leads to focus being set to document body instead of the triggering control. - Loading states: many components use aria-busy inconsistently; live regions for streaming operations are not present, which breaks progressive feedback in long-running tasks. - Table row action menus: popup menus are not always connected to the triggering button with aria-controls or aria-haspopup, resulting in poor NVDA navigation. Interaction State Matrix (condensed notes) - Primary button: hover (OK), focus (outline present but thin on dark), active (ripple present), disabled (non-interactive + aria-disabled true) -> need visible stronger focus ring in dark theme. - Secondary button: hover (subtle), focus (missing for keyboard on latest CSS refactor), suggestion -> restore keyboard focus rule and add 3px outline. - Dropdown/select: open/closed states toggled via aria-expanded (good), listitems -> missing aria-selected on keyboard selection in multi-select mode. - Tokenized input (chips): removable chips not receiving clear focus indicator; remove button lacks accessible name in some locales. - Table row actions: contextual menu buttons not described; role=menu is set but menuitems lack aria-checked or aria-pressed for toggles. - Modal dialogs: role=dialog present, but focus management broken when nested suggestions exist; add focus-sentinel guards and ensure focus returned to trigger on close. - Toasts/alerts: success toasts use polite live region sometimes but not consistently; long messages are truncated without expand mechanism for screen readers. Concrete examples and recommended fixes (priority ordered) 1) Keyboard focus visual parity (Priority: P0, Effort: 2 days) - Restore explicit :focus-visible rules for all button variants. In dark theme add 3:1 contrast shadow or 2px solid ring (token: --focus-ring-strong). Owner: Frontend (Samir). Ticket: JIRA-UI-9832. 2) Combobox ARIA selection (P0, Effort: 3 days) - When an item is selected using keyboard, set aria-selected="true" on the listitem and move aria-activedescendant appropriately. Verify with VoiceOver and NVDA. Add a unit test in storybook-a11y. Owner: Eng (Marco). Linked PR: github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2147. 3) Modal focus trap race (P1, Effort: 4 days) - Add focus sentinel elements before/after dialog content and ensure autosuggest close handlers await microtasks before setting focus. Add e2e test simulating fast open/close. Owner: Eng/Platform (Priya). Ticket: CONFLUENCE-REDWOOD-UI-4216. 4) Table menu semantics (P1, Effort: 2 days) - Ensure menu trigger button has aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-controls references the menu id. Menuitems should use role="menuitem" and state attributes for toggles. Owner: Eng (Jordan). 5) Live region standardization for streaming/long ops (P2, Effort: 3 days) - Introduce a single console-level live region utility (aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic) toggled by the runtime for important status updates. Document usage in the DS README. Owner: Design Systems. Wireframe callouts (for upcoming microinteraction sweep) - Primary/Secondary button states: include explicit frames in Figma showing hover, focus, pressed, disabled for 3 color tokens (light/dark/brand). Minimal motion only; show 90ms press feedback. - Dropdown focus highlight: propose a semi-opaque left bar (4px) as an affordance to avoid relying solely on border contrast. - Toast details: allow "expand" link for long messages (accessible via keyboard and announced to SRs). Backlog grooming (proposed tickets and sizing) - Restore-focus-rules-secondary-buttons (2d) -> owner Samir -> labels: a11y, frontend. - combobox-aria-selected-fix (3d) -> owner Marco -> a11y, eng. - modal-focus-sentinel (4d) -> owner Priya -> a11y, infra-test. - menu-trigger-aria-controls (2d) -> owner Jordan -> a11y. - live-region-utility (3d) -> owner Design Systems -> infra. Acceptance criteria examples (for PR reviews) - Keyboard-only: every interactive component in the story for the flow must be reachable and visually indicate focus. - Screen reader: sequences are announced in a sensible order; selected states reported; no orphaned focus. - Tests: storybook a11y checks should pass for the updated stories; add small puppeteer script to emulate VoiceOver-like announcements where possible. Open questions / notes to follow up - Internationalization: remove buttons use icon-only in some locales—confirm accessible name generation for localized copy. - Third-party lib versions: the dropdown lib upgrade planned May might change aria semantics; coordinate fixes to avoid duplication. - Mobile parity: once desktop fixes land, run a mobile-specific pass (separate ticket). Quick checklist for PR reviewers - [ ] Visual focus present in light + dark tokens - [ ] aria-expanded / aria-selected set appropriately - [ ] role attributes set for popups/menus - [ ] Focus return on modal close tested - [ ] Live region usage documented and centralized Appendix: Short code guidance snippets - Example: list item selection

Notes to self: keep this doc lean; these are working notes—move finalized patterns to the Console DS README and a Confluence page for a11y policy.
